title: feat: faster sandbox ssh reconnects and readable ssh errors
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: polli-cli 0.1.50 adds SSH connection sharing to sandbox configs, so repeat ssh, scp and rsync connections within 10 minutes can start in under a second. Existing users get the new config after their next `polli sandbox create` or `polli sandbox ssh-config`. Connection sharing is skipped on Windows or when the socket path would exceed OpenSSH's length limit. Keeping the connection open also keeps the sandbox running and paid longer: it pauses about 15–20 minutes after the last session, rather than 5–10; `ssh -O exit <id>.polli` closes the shared connection sooner. Sandbox connection refusals now print Gen's message and suggest `polli sandbox list` instead of showing raw JSON; this also improves stderr for timeout and lease-renewal errors. When OpenSSH discards proxy stderr, the CLI writes errors to the terminal if one is available; VS Code Remote-SSH without a terminal may still show only that the connection closed. Sandbox docs and the polli skill now cover port forwarding, VS Code Remote-SSH and pause timing. API routes and CLI commands are unchanged.
